name: Azul

categories.label: Wall placement
categories.help: Points earned each round for tiles you place on your wall.

categories.label: Floor penalty
categories.help: Penalty size each round for tiles on your floor line (enter it as a positive number).

categories.label: Complete rows
categories.help: Horizontal lines you filled (2 points each); the most wins a tie.

categories.label: Complete columns
categories.help: Vertical lines you filled (7 points each).

categories.label: Complete colours
categories.help: Colours with all five tiles on your wall (10 points each).

notes: Rounds are open ended: the game ends when someone completes a row. Enter one entry per round played. Category list recalled from the publisher rulebook and not yet re-checked against the printed copy (see source.checked_against_rulebook).
